async def act(page):
    # Scroll to the bottom of the homepage
    await page.evaluate('window.scrollTo(0, document.body.scrollHeight)')
    # Wait for any dynamic content like pagination to load
    await page.wait_for_timeout(2000)
    
    # Look for pagination controls to navigate to page 4
    # First, try to find a link with exact name '4' (case-insensitive by default)
    page4_link = page.get_by_role('link', name='4', exact=True)
    if await page4_link.count() > 0:
        await page4_link.first.click()
    else:
        # If no exact link, try to find a link with name containing '4' (substring match)
        page4_link_substring = page.get_by_role('link', name='4')
        if await page4_link_substring.count() > 0:
            await page4_link_substring.first.click()
        else:
            # Look for pagination within a navigation role
            nav_elements = page.get_by_role('navigation')
            if await nav_elements.count() > 0:
                # Check each navigation element for a link to page 4
                for i in range(await nav_elements.count()):
                    nav = nav_elements.nth(i)
                    link_in_nav = nav.get_by_role('link', name='4')
                    if await link_in_nav.count() > 0:
                        await link_in_nav.first.click()
                        break
                else:
                    # If no link found in navigation, search in the entire document again with a broader approach
                    # Use get_by_role to find all links and filter by href containing page indicators
                    all_links = page.get_by_role('link')
                    link_count = await all_links.count()
                    for i in range(link_count):
                        link = all_links.nth(i)
                        href = await link.get_attribute('href')
                        if href and ('page=4' in href or '/page/4' in href or 'paged=4' in href):
                            await link.click()
                            break
                    else:
                        # If still not found, assume pagination might be in a complementary or other role
                        complementary_elements = page.get_by_role('complementary')
                        if await complementary_elements.count() > 0:
                            for i in range(await complementary_elements.count()):
                                comp = complementary_elements.nth(i)
                                link_in_comp = comp.get_by_role('link', name='4')
                                if await link_in_comp.count() > 0:
                                    await link_in_comp.first.click()
                                    break
    # Wait for navigation to complete after clicking
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
